install_commands: python -I -c 'import sys, os; sys.path.append("/work/.reprobe_deps"); os.makedirs("/var/tmp/reprobe-pip", exist_ok=True); os.chdir("/var/tmp/reprobe-pip"); import importlib.util as u, subprocess; md = __import__("importlib.metadata", fromlist=["x"]) if u.find_spec("importlib.metadata") else None; pairs = [("pandas", "pandas")]; norm = lambda s: s.lower().replace("_", "-"); have = {norm(getattr(x, "name", "") or "") for x in md.distributions()} if md else set(); need = sorted({d for m, d in pairs if not m or (u.find_spec(m) is None and norm(d) not in have)}); print("reprobe: imports the environment does not provide:", need or "none", flush=True); W = "/var/tmp/reprobe-wheels"; run = lambda *a: subprocess.call([sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "pip", *a]); got = [d for d in need if run("download", "--no-input", "--only-binary=:all:", "-d", W, d) == 0]; T = ["--target=/work/.reprobe_deps"]; L = T and "/work/.reprobe_deps" or __import__("sysconfig").get_paths()["purelib"]; ls = lambda: sorted(os.listdir(L)) if os.path.isdir(L) else []; before = ls(); inst = lambda *ds: run("install", "--no-input", "--no-index", "--only-binary=:all:", "--find-links", W, *T, *ds); bad = bool(got) and inst(*got) != 0; retry = bad and ls() == before; ok = []; [ok.append(d) for d in (got if retry else []) if inst("--dry-run", "--quiet", *ok, d) == 0]; out = [d for d in got if d not in ok] if retry else []; out and print("reprobe: left out, they conflict with the imports kept:", out, flush=True); bad = bad and not (retry and ok and inst(*ok) == 0); done = got if not bad else []; done = ok if retry and not bad else done; fail = [d for d in need if d not in done]; print("reprobe: pip could NOT install (reported, not faked):", fail or "none")'

Rscript --vanilla -e 'if (requireNamespace("renv", quietly=TRUE)) { p <- file.path(tempdir(), "reprobe-renv"); dir.create(p, showWarnings=FALSE); stopifnot(file.copy("renv.lock", file.path(p, "renv.lock"), overwrite=TRUE)); lib <- Sys.getenv("R_LIBS_USER"); dir.create(lib, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE); renv::restore(project=p, library=lib, prompt=FALSE, repos=c(CRAN="https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/noble/2026-07-23"), exclude=NULL) } else { message("renv not preinstalled in image; renv.lock NOT restored"); quit(status=3) }'

Rscript --vanilla -e 'pkgs <- c("lme4"); repo <- "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/noble/2026-07-23"; options(HTTPUserAgent = sprintf("R/%s R (%s)", getRversion(), paste(getRversion(), R.version$platform, R.version$arch, R.version$os))); have <- rownames(installed.packages()); need <- setdiff(pkgs, have); if (length(need)) { avail <- tryCatch(rownames(available.packages(repos=repo)), error=function(e) character(0)); ok <- intersect(need, avail); miss <- setdiff(need, avail); if (length(ok)) install.packages(ok, repos=repo, lib=Sys.getenv("R_LIBS_USER")); if (length(miss)) message("reprobe: R packages not on CRAN (not installed): ", paste(miss, collapse=", ")); failed <- setdiff(ok, rownames(installed.packages())); if (length(failed)) { message("reprobe: CRAN packages FAILED to install: ", paste(failed, collapse=", ")); print(installed.packages()[, c("Package", "Version")]); quit(status=1) } }'
